K2.measured: Veyra 8 landmasses, 5 lakes, 17 rivers, 12 bridges, 27 docks, 23 zones, 92 roads, 81 POIs, 280 resource annotations, 4 spawns, 6 Elders; 12-code biome raster + 9 au road/river strokes.
K2.gameplayRule: PR44 terrainSpeed multipliers are pinned and used; the 12-code -> 14-string biome mapping is UNAPPROVED (GEO-02 blocker). Weather/trace/footprint state requires Gameplay simulation.
K2.missing: approved biome mapping; slope threshold; cart swept-clearance dimension; actual weather/hazard/trace exposure.

K3.measured: 280 authored resource annotations; per-spawn nearest and within-100/200/300 au counts in output/benchmark.v1.json resourceSuitability.
K3.gameplayRule: PR44 SOURCES/catalog.ts define finite stock, HP, regrow and loot; all 280 Veyra annotations remain conf=proposal and have no Gameplay source ID, stock, respawn or legality.
K3.missing: Gameplay source-ID mapping, stock/respawn policy, harvest legality for each annotated area.

K6.measured: per-scale POI foot tiles, entrance tiles, workspace tiles, room capacity, claim radius/min-distance in au; 3 alternative home zones measured from chosen spawn.
K6.gameplayRule: PR44 buildings 5x4..17x12 tiles, claimRadius=6 tiles, claimMinDistFromPoi=10 tiles, tenderLinkTiles=3, build range 4.6*TILE, near interaction 3 tiles; POI doors/power/loot/retreat are Gameplay-owned states.
K6.missing: canonical Veyra POIs have NO authored doors/rooms/corridors/workspaces; GEO-02 PROPOSED shell is not canonical and has no validated door/swept clearance. Human 640x360 room test.

K7.measured: 51 source-linked journeys; 41 have straight-line + terrain-weighted raster route + loaded-cart scenario times for U=1/2/4/8, 10 are explicitly UNRESOLVED with no fabricated time; authored RT-1/RT-2/RT-3 corridor times with trail/cart split.
K7.gameplayRule: PR44 cart speedOnRoad=1.36 / speedOffRoad=0.72 / speedRough=0.42, weight penalty 0.18 per 100, maxWeight=240 / freight=360, carts cannot ford water, moveBody radii 4/5 px.
blockers: authored cart-road raster has 6 disconnected 8-connected components; largest=643 cells
RT-1 contains rd_13 / rd_1w / rd_16 which are kind=trail — NEVER cart-passable
GEO-02 measured po_kilns nearest cart road rd_n at 56.8792 au > ACCESS_R=48, foot trail rd_16 at 0 au; br_a foot-only crossing 0.0342 au; one zero-clearance cell [732,652]
no swept-clearance dimension exists in Veyra source; bridge-to-channel fit UNVERIFIED
10 of 51 measured ODs have NO connected foot route on the accepted masks: separate landmasses / unbridged channels; Veyra has kind=ferry roads but PR44 HEAD has NO approved ferry or boat rule
K7.missing: Gameplay cart footprint/swept-clearance rule, slope/bridge/water thresholds, continuous cargo road authoring, approved ferry/boat/cargo rule for the 8 landmasses, exposure_time from creature simulation, freight repair/fuel cost.

K8.measured: run clock = 336 h = 1209600 s (real elapsed ms, HOUR=3600000); Ragnarok final 72 h; fictional day 24 min. All modelled times are real seconds and converted to game hours.
K8.gameplayRule: phaseOf/dayTime/endRun/weatherAt use runElapsedMs; offline causality is event-driven.
K8.missing: world-size streaming/LOD and offline simulation for a >40,000-cell world; save size and mapDigest budget; no full-world integration claim.

MAP-SPAWN-04.bibleRequirement: Bốn điểm spawn ở các miền khác nhau, thử không Core vẫn có nước, thức ăn, nguồn làm công cụ, road/offroad, đường tới vùng có thể dựng nhà
MAP-SPAWN-04.insufficientEvidence: Chỉ điểm spawn “an toàn” trên sơ đồ
MAP-SPAWN-04.missing: 30–60 min blind-novice play without Core, real water/food/tool source IDs, collision and road/offroad choice; "safe dot on a map" is explicitly insufficient.

MAP-HOME-03.bibleRequirement: Ba nhà do người thử tự chọn từ đất hợp lệ; đúng collision, mái, vườn/lò, freight và các lần giao tuyến quái khác nhau
MAP-HOME-03.missing: three houses actually built by testers, collision/roof/garden/furnace, freight and differing monster-route encounters; buildable % is explicitly insufficient.

MAP-LOG-03.bibleRequirement: Một POI nguồn có đường người và đường xe khác biệt, một kho xa có giá trị tăng sau khi được xe, một tuyến bị thời tiết/địch làm thay đổi quyết định
MAP-LOG-03.missing: real item/collision/cart instance, a continuous physically verified cargo route, weather/enemy-driven route change; no incomplete trail may be labelled cart-passable.

MAP-U4.bibleRequirement: Không boss: kiếm tiền cuối72 → đến người bán rương mua bằng tiền vật lý → về căn cứ của mình → đặt rương → ký gửi số tiền dương → tùy chọn rời đảo
MAP-U4.missing: Bible §5.4 explicitly leaves price, stock, seller, distance, land rights, number of trips and route optimality unfixed; physical cash→purchase→claim→deposit run with real items.

MAP-U5.bibleRequirement: Sáu Elder có vùng thật trước/sau thức tỉnh; các nguồn điểm khác nhau không phải một arena chung; ít nhất một lối sơ tán no-boss
MAP-U5.missing: pre/post-awakening physical regions with distinct sources, one verified no-boss retreat, six Elder sprites/AI beyond the Web prototype; symmetric coloured zones are explicitly insufficient.

assumptions: U is defined as authoring units per ONE runtime tile of TILE=16 px; 1 au = 16/U px and base speed = 72*U/16 au/s.
PR44 run clock is real elapsed milliseconds (HOUR=3600_000); modelled seconds are real seconds and 1 game hour = 3600 s. The 24-minute day/night clock is separate and fictional.
12 MapLab biome codes are mapped to PR44 terrainSpeed keys by documented assumption; GEO-02 explicitly says this mapping is NOT approved.
Raster Dijkstra uses the accepted GEO-01/02 8-au land/water/road/bridge masks. It is a geographic route estimate, NOT a Gameplay collision or swept-clearance verdict.
Road/bridge/river widths used as scale probes are EDITOR analysis strokes / display glyphs, NOT authored physical dimensions.
Memory figures are lower-bound byte models from PR44 array declarations; no streaming/LOD loader exists in PR44 HEAD.
The 3.696 au west entrance and 57.4232 au² workspace come from the GEO-02 PROPOSED po_kilns shell and are NOT canonical Veyra geometry.
Loaded-cart cases are modelled on the SAME geographic foot route with the PR44 cart speed/weight profile; they are not cart-passability claims.

recommendation.creatorRule: MAP DESIGNS THE PHYSICAL WORLD. GAMEPLAY POPULATES AND SIMULATES IT.
recommendation.decision: U=2 authoring units per runtime tile is the only diagnostic candidate that keeps entrances, rooms, workspaces, roads, rivers and bridges physically representable while staying inside the 1,000,000-cell economy validator. It is NOT approved: PR44 core.ts (WW=WH=200), validateRuntimeMapPackage() (exact 200x200 @16), render.ts chunk key stride, seaDist BFS stop and the absent streaming implementation must all be changed and re-tested before any full-world intake.
recommendation.notChosenBecause: No scale was chosen for convenient integer dimensions, for matching the 40,000-cell runtime, or for attractive traversal times alone. U=8 exactly reproduces the 250x175 source raster / ~43,750 cells but destroys entrances, interiors and bridge detail.
